is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae (page 1, 'Insecticide resistant Anopheles gambiae have enhanced longevity...').

reports_target_markers.evidence: Mentions kdr mutations L1014S (Vgsc L995S) and L1014F (Vgsc L995F) in the mosquito colonies (page 2, 'kdr mutations with allele frequencies of 77% (L1014S) and 23% (L1014F)').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Does not report primary/extractable genotype counts or frequencies from newly genotyped populations; kdr allele frequencies for the colony lines are cited from a previous study (Machani et al. 2020, ref 17) (page 2).

african_field_population.evidence: Experiments were performed using laboratory-reared/selected lines (6th generation resistant colony, 13th generation susceptible colony, and the Kisumu reference lab strain) rather than field-caught (F0) or F1 mosquitoes (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical study measuring gonotrophic cycle, fecundity, and adult longevity under semi-field conditions (pages 1-3).

sub_country_location.evidence: Original colony collected in Bungoma, western Kenya; experiments conducted in Kisumu, Kenya (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The paper does not state the collection year range for the field-collected mother colony.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The mosquito colonies and their kdr genotype frequencies are derived directly from Machani et al. 2020 (ref 17) (page 2).

supplement.evidence: Supplementary Table S1 is cited for colony characteristics, but eligibility fails on core requirements (lack of primary extractable genotype data and use of lab colonies).

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the fitness costs of pyrethroid resistance (gonotrophic cycle length, fecundity, and longevity) in Anopheles gambiae using lab-selected multi-generation colonies (F6 resistant and F13 susceptible) originally derived from Bungoma, Kenya, alongside the Kisumu reference strain. It does not report new genotype data for field populations.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report primary/extractable genotype data for target markers (kdr frequencies are cited from a previous paper).
Tested mosquitoes are laboratory-selected/reared colonies (F6 and F13 generations) and reference strains rather than African field populations (F0 or F1).
